evidence.observation: Purge brought O2 down from 28763 ppm to about 3 ppm, and it has stayed low
T followed the ramp setpoint closely; a brief overshoot to 760.5 is settling to 752.4 at 750 setpoint
Ar holds at about 100 sccm and P at about 760.5 Torr
Heater power dropped to about 40% for the hold, which fits the lower demand once ramping stops

args.missing_evidence: No sample characterization yet, and no reference ranges were provided to confirm the growth-stage overshoot and heater power are typical.
